channel.title: WWE's Greatest Moments
channel.desc: The elimination chamber has struck fear into WWE superstars for over 20 years, leading to the creation of its own namesake event; relive some of the shocking moments from the premium live event, like Goldberg spearing Chris Jericho through the plexiglass in 2003, the first-ever women's elimination chamber in 2018, the debut of Kevin Owens as he takes on John Cena in 2015 and more.
